security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Watch a spreadsheet while an AI agent edits it
bundle.longDescription: Total Recalc is a fast, read-only spreadsheet viewer that refreshes itself whenever the file changes, keeps your place, and shows exactly what the agent edited and what recalculated as a result.
